title: Step 60-G listing SEO states accessibility and responsive hardening
description: Harden the existing Search and Category listing surfaces only. Search is noindex; canonical category URLs are based on the authoritative category slug and a site-owned origin, never untrusted request Host. Only successful unfiltered first-page category listings are indexable; filtered/sorted/cursor, missing, invalid and failed states remain noindex. Preserve bounded GET retry and authoritative data, expose filtered-empty distinctly, announce pending navigation without inventing results, and make mobile filter disclosure keyboard/ARIA-accessible while preserving desktop access, RTL, 44px targets, reduced-motion and 400% reflow. Add deterministic metadata/state checks and a mock-backed browser gate to the existing pinned free Storefront Quality workflow. No backend/OpenAPI/database, new dependency, unrelated route, full Step60 acceptance/prototype (H), or Roadmap/Current-State closure (I).

acceptance_criteria.description: Search remains noindex and does not manufacture a canonical URL; only successful unfiltered first-page Category may be indexable. Other Category dimensions and unavailable states are noindex, with the category base canonical URL constructed from authoritative slug and fixed origin.

Filtered-empty differs from general no-result. Loading navigation announces a pending state, retaining the previous verified listing until the new loader settles. All retries remain explicit and bounded GET only.

Mobile filter disclosure supports keyboard and aria-expanded/controls; desktop remains fully accessible. RTL, 44px targets, six widths, 400% reflow proxy, reduced motion and zero WCAG-tagged axe findings are checked on mock-backed Search and Category surfaces.
No pricing/inventory authority, backend/OpenAPI/database migration, new dependency, Step60-H acceptance/prototype, or Step60-I final state sync is included.

Exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality, deterministic Review, artifact-bound ACTIVE Lock, protected Merge Policy transport, exact-SHA postmerge verify and terminal Lock release are required before 60-H.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Provider risk classification is authoritative; HIGH escalation requires Security and Owner Human Gate.
